text:
maria: FYI I've opened a PR to split the network and service modules and to pin provider versions at the root. Need quick eyes on lockfile regen and the k8s secret path changes before I move forward. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482

jasper: looking now. do we expect a state move for any resources or just module address renames?

maria: module addresses will change (network -> network_v2). we'll need state mv for a couple of VPC/Subnet resources. also seeing CI error about provider version mismatch — plan fails on terraform init unless we regen lockfile. planning to pin hashicorp/aws = "4.60.0" at the root and add required_providers blocks in modules.

lee: I hit the CI init error locally too: "Incompatible provider version". regen .terraform.lock.hcl and commit is needed, otherwise CI blocks. happy to push the regen commit if you want.

devin: if you're doing state moves, let's schedule a short maintenance window. example state mv: `terraform state mv module.network.aws_vpc.main module.network_v2.aws_vpc.main` — will also validate with a temp workspace and run a smoke apply against staging. I can automate the mv in a script.

sana: heads up on secrets: the new module writes the DB credentials into namespace `infra-system` with name `db-credentials`. apps currently look for `default/db-credentials`. we need to either copy the secret or update deployments. example manifest we use in the module:```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: db-credentials
  namespace: infra-system
stringData:
  username: ${var.db_user}
  password: ${var.db_pass}
```
Make sure apps reference `infra-system/db-credentials` or we should run a copy.

maria: good catch — added a migration note in the PR and a one-liner to copy secrets in-cluster: `kubectl get secret old-secret -n default -o yaml | sed 's/namespace: default/namespace: infra-system/' | kubectl apply -f -`

jasper: :thumbsup: I'll run terraform init && plan locally and paste a short plan snippet if there are risky replacements.

jasper: snippet from my local plan:```Plan: 2 to add, 1 to change, 3 to destroy.
-/+ module.network_v2.aws_subnet.main (forces replacement) -> will recreate with new addresses```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: CI plan is available: https://ci.redwood.com/infra/plan/482 (includes init + plan output)

lee: small recommendation: add provider pinning and a short lockfile-regen step to the module README and CONTRIBUTING.md so external consumers don't get surprised. also call out the secret namespace change.

maria: will do — adding a checklist in the PR description: regen lockfile, update README, run state mv script in staging, copy secrets, smoke test, and rollback steps. tagging @devin @jasper for final check.

devin: I can smoke tomorrow 09:00 PT. plan to run the regen + state mv in staging and validate application access to the DB secret. I'll coordinate with oncall.

jasper: LGTM from my side after local plan. minor note: watch for duplicate provider installation if modules declare different required_providers; hoisting to root should avoid it.

maria: thanks all — I'll push the lockfile commit and update the PR with the checklist and rollback instructions. will ping here when it's ready for the smoke run.
